correctness.rationale: The base action forces every fixed point onto t=1 or t=-1. Proposition 4.13 shows both fibers are smooth. Exact substitution into the source formulas gives four distinct y=0 points on t=1; on t=-1 it gives two affine points and two fixed weighted-projective points at infinity. These eight points exhaust the fixed locus and agree with the Nikulin count.
